I wrote `component.html` in the folder. It's the 1280px Approvals screen inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Content:** The page has the "Approvals" heading and the "3 waiting for you" line. It also has the three cards you listed, each with its title, requester, amount, an "Approve" button and a "Decline" button.
- **Design rules:** I followed `DESIGN.md` for colors, type sizes, spacing, radii and pill buttons. "Approve" is the filled button and "Decline" is the quiet one. I added an accent-line border to "Decline" so it still reads as a button.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available in this folder, so the page names them first and falls back to Helvetica or Arial. The headings will look different until those fonts are installed.
- **Other files:** `session.json` was empty and `session.err` only held a model-name warning, so neither changed anything.
